description:
Useful Planetary Shield

v0.1.2 — for Starsector 0.98a-RC5

Ever built a

Planetary Shield

, watched the pretty bubble wrap around your world, and then watched a Luddic Path crisis fleet saturation-bomb it into rubble anyway?

That's not a bug. In vanilla the Planetary Shield industry does

nothing

against orbital bombardment — it's a x3 ground-defense multiplier (anti-raid/invasion), a meteor-suppressor, and a cosmetic shield texture. The one thing its name promises, it does not do.

Useful Planetary Shield

gives it that job — with a tradeoff so it isn't a free "my colony is now invincible" button.

Download

UsefulPlanetaryShield-0.1.2.zip

Extract into your Starsector mods/ folder and enable it in the launcher.

What it does

While the shield is

operational

(built and not disrupted), a tactical or saturation bombardment of the colony is largely absorbed:

Industry disruption is cut to 50% of its normal durationStability loss from the bombardment is cut to 50%No pollution is inflicted on habitable worldsThe colony cannot be reduced in size by a saturation strikeThe colony cannot be decivilized — by bombardment or stability collapseIn exchange, the vanilla x3 ground-defense bonus is removed — the shield stops bombs, not marines

The catch (and the balance):

a bombardment the shield absorbs also

knocks the shield generator offline

— at least 60 days for a tactical strike (configurable), and the full (halved) disruption for a saturation strike. So a shielded colony shrugs off the

first

strike and is then exposed until the shield repairs. A sustained bombardment campaign still gets through — you just can't be one-shotted, and you get a fighting chance to intercept the follow-up or resolve the crisis.

This works against every source of bombardment: Luddic Path / Remnant / Sindrian Diktat colony crises, and any modded faction that bombards you.

Configuration

Every value above is adjustable. With

LunaLib

enabled (optional) you get an in-game settings menu; without it, the mod reads bundled defaults from data/config/settings.json and runs fine standalone.

You can tune the disruption/stability percentages, toggle the pollution / size / deciv protections individually, restore the vanilla ground-defense bonus, and restrict the effect to player colonies only.

Requirements & compatibility

Starsector 0.98a-RC5LunaLib — optional, for the in-game config menuSafe to add to an existing saveSafe to remove — but first turn off "Block Decivilization" (or let the shield go offline) and load+save once, so no protection flag is left behind on a colony. (Details in the README.)Conflict: any other mod that replaces the vanilla planetaryshield industry plugin. This mod swaps that plugin to drop the ground-defense bonus; only one can win.

How it works

(for the curious)

SpoilerVanilla has no cancellable pre-bombardment hook — the AI crisis path calls the bombardment directly and fires no listeners, and the player-side listeners are post-hoc. So the mitigation is

reactive

: a lightweight script snapshots each shielded colony a few times a day (industry disruption, unrest, size, pollution, the "recently bombarded" flag), detects a strike, and — if the shield was up when it landed — rolls the effects partway back.

Decivilization is prevented

proactively

by giving shielded colonies the game's own story-critical flag, which every bombardment path already checks to downgrade "destroy" into a survivable size hit. The flag is tracked carefully so a flag set by the base game or another mod is never disturbed, and it's removed the instant the shield stops working.

Fully source-available; the repo README documents the exact code paths.[close]

Changelog

v0.1.2

Absorbing a tactical bombardment now also knocks the shield offline (min 60 days, configurable, 0 = old behavior). Vanilla tac strikes only disrupt military-tagged industries and never touch the shield, so tac bombs were being absorbed for free, forever. Saturation strikes already disrupted the shield; the new value acts as a floor there.

v0.1.1

Shields already built before installing the mod are now migrated on game load (they kept the vanilla plugin class, so their tooltip and ground-defense removal didn't apply). AI cores, improvements, and disruption state carry over.

v0.1.0

Initial release.

Disclaimer: This post and mod were written using Claude's Fable AI model.
descriptionHtml:
Useful Planetary Shield
v0.1.2 — for Starsector 0.98a-RC5

Ever built a Planetary Shield, watched the pretty bubble wrap around your world, and then watched a Luddic Path crisis fleet saturation-bomb it into rubble anyway?

That's not a bug. In vanilla the Planetary Shield industry does nothing against orbital bombardment — it's a x3 ground-defense multiplier (anti-raid/invasion), a meteor-suppressor, and a cosmetic shield texture. The one thing its name promises, it does not do.

Useful Planetary Shield gives it that job — with a tradeoff so it isn't a free "my colony is now invincible" button.




Download

UsefulPlanetaryShield-0.1.2.zip

Extract into your Starsector mods/ folder and enable it in the launcher.


What it does

While the shield is operational (built and not disrupted), a tactical or saturation bombardment of the colony is largely absorbed:

  • Industry disruption is cut to 50% of its normal duration
  • Stability loss from the bombardment is cut to 50%
  • No pollution is inflicted on habitable worlds
  • The colony cannot be reduced in size by a saturation strike
  • The colony cannot be decivilized — by bombardment or stability collapse
  • In exchange, the vanilla x3 ground-defense bonus is removed — the shield stops bombs, not marines

The catch (and the balance): a bombardment the shield absorbs also knocks the shield generator offline — at least 60 days for a tactical strike (configurable), and the full (halved) disruption for a saturation strike. So a shielded colony shrugs off the first strike and is then exposed until the shield repairs. A sustained bombardment campaign still gets through — you just can't be one-shotted, and you get a fighting chance to intercept the follow-up or resolve the crisis.

This works against every source of bombardment: Luddic Path / Remnant / Sindrian Diktat colony crises, and any modded faction that bombards you.


Configuration

Every value above is adjustable. With LunaLib enabled (optional) you get an in-game settings menu; without it, the mod reads bundled defaults from data/config/settings.json and runs fine standalone.

You can tune the disruption/stability percentages, toggle the pollution / size / deciv protections individually, restore the vanilla ground-defense bonus, and restrict the effect to player colonies only.


Requirements & compatibility

  • Starsector 0.98a-RC5
  • LunaLib — optional, for the in-game config menu
  • Safe to add to an existing save
  • Safe to remove — but first turn off "Block Decivilization" (or let the shield go offline) and load+save once, so no protection flag is left behind on a colony. (Details in the README.)
  • Conflict: any other mod that replaces the vanilla planetaryshield industry plugin. This mod swaps that plugin to drop the ground-defense bonus; only one can win.


How it works (for the curious)

SpoilerVanilla has no cancellable pre-bombardment hook — the AI crisis path calls the bombardment directly and fires no listeners, and the player-side listeners are post-hoc. So the mitigation is reactive: a lightweight script snapshots each shielded colony a few times a day (industry disruption, unrest, size, pollution, the "recently bombarded" flag), detects a strike, and — if the shield was up when it landed — rolls the effects partway back.

Decivilization is prevented proactively by giving shielded colonies the game's own story-critical flag, which every bombardment path already checks to downgrade "destroy" into a survivable size hit. The flag is tracked carefully so a flag set by the base game or another mod is never disturbed, and it's removed the instant the shield stops working.

Fully source-available; the repo README documents the exact code paths.[close]

Changelog

v0.1.2
  • Absorbing a tactical bombardment now also knocks the shield offline (min 60 days, configurable, 0 = old behavior). Vanilla tac strikes only disrupt military-tagged industries and never touch the shield, so tac bombs were being absorbed for free, forever. Saturation strikes already disrupted the shield; the new value acts as a floor there.

v0.1.1
  • Shields already built before installing the mod are now migrated on game load (they kept the vanilla plugin class, so their tooltip and ground-defense removal didn't apply). AI cores, improvements, and disruption state carry over.

v0.1.0
  • Initial release.

Disclaimer: This post and mod were written using Claude's Fable AI model.
